Badminton athletes invest immense time and energy in their training to prepare for their competitions. This demanding sport requires not only speed and endurance, but also precise technique and strategic thinking. The Olympic Games are the absolute pinnacle of any sporting career. Every athlete trains with the aim of being at the peak of their performance and giving their best at precisely this most important moment.
